Sandbox_KIPNCareers_CurrencyItemType_too: Full item type used for every Careers Framework transaction across all careers (licenses, escrow, payouts). Falls back to Base.Money if the type is missing.
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_CurrencyItemValue_to: Monetary value of one currency item. License prices are rounded up to the next multiple of this; a player's own offer must be an exact multiple.
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_FlyersPerRestart: Flyers distributed per business after restart
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_ThreatsEnabled_toolt: Server-controlled thieves, raiders, difficult customers and ambushes for every installed career. Incidents only start while the business owner is online and nearby.
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_ThreatFrequencyPerce: Scales how often incidents start. 100 = normal, 0 = never, 300 = three times as often.
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_ThreatMinCalmHours: Minimum calm hours after an incident
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_ThreatMinCalmHours_t: After an incident a business stays quiet for a random time between the minimum and maximum (shorter at higher reputation tiers).
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_ThreatMaxCalmHours: Maximum calm hours after an incident
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_ThreatNewBusinessGra: Grace period for a new business (hours)
No unscripted incidents for this many in-game hours after a business opens.
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_ThreatMaxLossPercent: Maximum share of stock stolen per incident (%)
Caps how much of a building's stock thieves can take in one incident. Stolen goods drop where a thief dies.
Sandbox_KIPNCareers_ThreatOwnerRadius_to: Incidents at a business only start while its owner is within this many tiles of it.
